subject: Aligning PO setup & payment cadence for Greenline Technologies integration
content:
From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@greenline.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO setup and payment cadence question for Redwood integration

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again — Greenline is ready to move forward with the integration. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we raise the PO:

- What payment terms does Redwood default to for new integrations?
- Do you require a particular PO template or a specific vendor onboarding packet?
- We sometimes request Net 60 for larger vendors; is Redwood open to Net 60 or an early-pay / discount arrangement instead?

We can be flexible if we have the onboarding docs and bank details. If you have a PO template, could you also indicate who to send invoices to once the PO is generated?

Attaching our initial SOW request for context (SOW_redwood_greenline.docx).

Best,
Jared
Procurement Lead | Greenline Technologies

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@greenline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup and payment cadence question for Redwood integration

Hi Jared — welcome, and great to hear Greenline is moving forward. Quick answers and next steps below.

- Default payment term: Net 45 for new enterprise customers (standard for integrations).
- Exceptions: We can make exceptions to Net 45 via approval; Net 60 is possible but requires Finance sign-off and a commercial justification.
- Early-pay program: We offer a 1% discount if payment is received within 15 days (applies to invoices > $5k, eligible on a per-invoice basis).
- Vendor onboarding: Please complete our vendor onboarding form and provide a W-9 and ACH details. I can send the template — looping in Laura from Finance to confirm exact docs.

If Greenline needs Net 60, please share the procurement rationale (e.g., enterprise AR policy, consolidated monthly cutoffs) and we can fast-track an exception review. Otherwise, many customers prefer Net 45 + early-pay terms which preserves cashflow for both sides.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Greenline returns completed onboarding_form_filled.pdf + W-9_Greenline.pdf + bank info (secure link or portal).
2) Our Finance generates PO (or we accept your PO format) and we confirm invoice remittance instructions.
3) If you want Net 60, send the justification and we’ll route to Finance — typical review time 3–5 business days.

CC: Laura — can you confirm the list of required attachments and whether we need additional compliance docs?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@greenline.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup and payment cadence question for Redwood integration

Hi Jared,

Thanks for looping us in. For vendor setup and to issue a PO we need the following completed and received by finance@redwood.com:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (onboarding_form_filled.pdf)
- W-9 (W-9_Greenline.pdf) or W-8 if non-US entity
- ACH details or remittance instructions (PDF with bank name, routing, acct number or a secure vendor portal upload)
- If you prefer Redwood to accept your PO template, include a copy; otherwise we issue our PO and attach your SOW.

About payment terms: Redwood's standard is Net 45 for new customers. Exceptions to Net 45 (including Net 60) are escalated to Finance + Sales leadership with one of the following:
- Procurement policy requiring Net 60 (pdf or procurement policy statement), or
- Volume/commitment justification (e.g., 12-month minimum spend or committed reserved capacity).

We do have an early-pay program that can meet the spirit of Net 60 requests while keeping our unit economics intact: 1% discount if payment is made within 15 days. That is typically faster than Net 60 and helps both parties. If Greenline wants to pursue a Net 60 exception, please include a short justification and we will prioritize review.

For the PO cadence: Finance prefers monthly POs for subscription/recurring services, or single PO per pilot if that’s easier. We can accept either monthly PO increments or a single annual PO — let us know which works for your procurement system.

Once we receive the forms I’ll confirm the PO number and remittance details.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

---

From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@greenline.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup and payment cadence question for Redwood integration

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

Thanks for the clarity. Attached: onboarding_form_filled.pdf and W-9_Greenline.pdf — bank details attached as ACH_info.pdf (we uploaded to your secure portal). Greenline procurement has reviewed and we are comfortable with Net 45; Net 60 is not required.

We prefer to submit a monthly PO cadence (procurement in our ERP prefers monthly POs tied to each invoice). Please issue PO(s) on a monthly basis and we’ll route invoices to accounts.payable@greenline.com.

Are you able to issue a PO referencing our ERP vendor ID: GL-ERP-5521? If so we’ll accept your PO and confirm on our side.

Best,
Jared

Attachments: onboarding_form_filled.pdf, W-9_Greenline.pdf, ACH_info.pdf

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@greenline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO setup and payment cadence question for Redwood integration

Thanks Jared — we received the forms and portal upload. Finance has generated the first PO. Details below and attached.

- PO number: RLW-GL-2025-089
- PO scope: initial integration month + pilot usage (see attached PO_RLW-GL-2025-089.pdf and PO_template_filled.xlsx)
- Payment terms on PO: Net 45 (per Finance policy)
- Early-pay discount: 1% if payment received within 15 days (applies per invoice)
- Invoice remittance: accounts.receivable@redwood.com; please include PO # on invoice and send PDFs to accounts.payable@greenline.com as well

Next steps for us:
- I’ve attached the filled PO template. Please confirm the ERP vendor ID (GL-ERP-5521) is correct so we can sync systems.
- If Greenline wants consolidated monthly POs instead of one PO per invoice, confirm and we’ll adjust cadence starting next month.

Closing the loop here — welcome aboard and let me know if you need the DocuSign copy of the SOW/PO executed.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_RLW-GL-2025-089.pdf (stub), PO_template_filled.xlsx (stub), onboarding_form_filled.pdf (from earlier), W-9_Greenline.pdf
